Container.Name: traefik-geoip-filter
Container.Overview: A Docker container that works as a GeoIP allow/blocklist middleware for Traefik. Uses the Maxmind GeoLite2 database.
Container.Requires: - Traefik on the same Docker network - Middleware (forwardAuth) configuration in Traefik - Account on MaxMind.com (free)

Config.Name: MaxMind license key
Config.Description: The MaxMind license key you generated

Config.Name: Filter type
Config.Description: Set the filter as an allow or blocklist (possible values: allow, blocklist)

Config.Name: Country codes
Config.Description: List of countries you want to allow/block IPs from, separated by spaces. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2#Officially_assigned_code_elements

Config.Name: Sub codes
Config.Description: List of locations smaller than a country that you want to allow/block IPs from. Separated by spaces. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2#Current_codes

Config.Name: Extra IPs
Config.Description: Append additional IPs to the filter list, separated by spaces. E.g. LAN, Vaultwarden network. E.g. 10.0.0.0/32 172.16.0.0/16 192.168.0.0/24. Optional.
